summary: Safe Bulkers filed a 6-K announcing a contemplated private placement of approximately 12,000,000 new common shares, exclusively to institutional investors outside the U.S. under Regulation S, with pricing set via accelerated bookbuilding in EUR. CEO Polys Hajioannou, the largest shareholder, committed to subscribe for 2,000,000 shares, subject to scale-back. Managers include Piraeus Bank, DNB Carnegie and Fearnley Securities. Proceeds target liquidity, newbuild financing and general corporate purposes. A 180-day lock-up applies to the company, board and management. Trading on Euronext Athens is suspended pending completion. Watch allocation, pricing discount and dilution versus Hajioannou's participation.
